records.context: Some phenotypes are broad and show on many columns, others are thin and show only on the few columns that carry them. Each view (a named subset of the profile's columns) is embedded, whitened on the non-targeting genes and turned into calibrated gene-pair scores: every pair similarity becomes a normal score against that view's own guide-permutation null, pooled within bins of the two genes' cell counts. The projection keeps, for every pair, its strongest calibrated score over the views, and a joint permutation null of that maximum (Westfall-Young) gives each pair a p value. The pairs then form a graph that Leiden clusters, and every cluster is labelled by the views its edges came from.
records.label: spacr.ops_maxproj#1
records.source: Some phenotypes are broad and show on many columns, others are thin and show only on the few columns that carry them. Each view (a named subset of the profile's columns) is embedded, whitened on the non-targeting genes and turned into calibrated gene-pair scores: every pair similarity becomes a normal score against that view's own guide-permutation null, pooled within bins of the two genes' cell counts. The projection keeps, for every pair, its strongest calibrated score over the views, and a joint permutation null of that maximum (Westfall-Young) gives each pair a p value. The pairs then form a graph that Leiden clusters, and every cluster is labelled by the views its edges came from.
records.translation: Alguns fenótipos são amplos e aparecem em muitas colunas; outros se restringem às poucas colunas que os refletem. Cada vista (um subconjunto nomeado das colunas do perfil) é representada em um espaço de menor dimensão, branqueada com base nos genes não direcionados e convertida em pontuações calibradas de pares de genes: cada similaridade entre pares se torna uma pontuação da distribuição normal em relação à distribuição nula de permutações de guias da própria vista, agrupada em intervalos das contagens de células dos dois genes. A projeção mantém, para cada par, sua maior pontuação calibrada entre as vistas, e uma distribuição nula conjunta por permutação desse máximo (Westfall-Young) fornece um valor p para cada par. Os pares então formam um grafo que Leiden agrupa, e cada cluster é rotulado pelas vistas das quais suas arestas vieram.
records.review_basis: Codex (OpenAI) AI translation and review on 2026-11-21 of the assigned item 992 max-projection clustering runtime rows and API blocks. No human or native-speaker signoff.

records.context: The null distributions are kept as counts on a fixed grid, so memory does not grow with the number of permutations; every draw is seeded from ``ops_maxproj_seed`` and its index, in a fixed order, so the results do not depend on the worker count.

records.source: The null distributions are kept as counts on a fixed grid, so memory does not grow with the number of permutations; every draw is seeded from ``ops_maxproj_seed`` and its index, in a fixed order, so the results do not depend on the worker count.
records.translation: As distribuições nulas são mantidas como contagens em uma grade fixa, de modo que a memória não cresce com o número de permutações; a semente de cada sorteio vem de ``ops_maxproj_seed`` e de seu índice, em uma ordem fixa, por isso os resultados não dependem do número de processos de trabalho.

records.source: Reads the views file (``ops_maxproj_views``), scores every gene pair in every view (``ops_maxproj_similarity``, :func:`view_similarity`) against that view's guide-permutation null (:func:`maxproj_scores`), keeps each pair's strongest score over the views, tests it against the joint max-statistic null, builds the projected graph (:func:`projected_graph`, or PHATE on the projected scores with ``ops_maxproj_graph`` ``'phate'``), runs Leiden over ``ops_maxproj_resolutions`` and ``ops_maxproj_leiden_seeds`` plus the partition matched to the target count (``ops_maxproj_k``, else :func:`spacr.ops_clusters.target_cluster_count`), and labels every cluster by the views its edges came from (:func:`label_clusters_by_view`).
records.translation: Lê o arquivo de vistas (``ops_maxproj_views``), pontua cada par de genes em cada vista (``ops_maxproj_similarity``, :func:`view_similarity`) em relação à distribuição nula de permutações de guias dessa vista (:func:`maxproj_scores`), mantém a maior pontuação de cada par entre as vistas, testa-a em relação à distribuição nula conjunta da estatística máxima, constrói o grafo projetado (:func:`projected_graph`, ou PHATE sobre as pontuações projetadas com ``ops_maxproj_graph`` ``'phate'``), executa Leiden com ``ops_maxproj_resolutions`` e ``ops_maxproj_leiden_seeds`` mais a partição ajustada ao número-alvo (``ops_maxproj_k``, ou então :func:`spacr.ops_clusters.target_cluster_count`), e rotula cada cluster pelas vistas das quais suas arestas vieram (:func:`label_clusters_by_view`).

records.context: The view's columns are embedded as the evaluate phase embeds a profile (:func:`spacr.ops_reference.embed_gene_profiles`: standardise, PCA keeping ``variance``), then whitened on the non-targeting genes in the PCA space (:func:`spacr.ops_tvn.tvn_on_controls`, one batch). ``'cosine'`` is the cosine of the whitened rows. ``'shrunk'`` is ``x . y / sqrt((|x|^2 + c) (|y|^2 + c))`` with ``c`` the mean squared norm of the non-targeting rows (the component count once whitened): a gene no stronger than the controls stays near zero, which plain cosine cannot do in a view of few columns, where unrelated genes often point the same way.

records.source: The view's columns are embedded as the evaluate phase embeds a profile (:func:`spacr.ops_reference.embed_gene_profiles`: standardise, PCA keeping ``variance``), then whitened on the non-targeting genes in the PCA space (:func:`spacr.ops_tvn.tvn_on_controls`, one batch). ``'cosine'`` is the cosine of the whitened rows. ``'shrunk'`` is ``x . y / sqrt((|x|^2 + c) (|y|^2 + c))`` with ``c`` the mean squared norm of the non-targeting rows (the component count once whitened): a gene no stronger than the controls stays near zero, which plain cosine cannot do in a view of few columns, where unrelated genes often point the same way.
records.translation: As colunas da vista são representadas em um espaço de menor dimensão como a fase de avaliação faz com um perfil (:func:`spacr.ops_reference.embed_gene_profiles`: padronização e PCA que mantém ``variance``), depois são branqueadas com base nos genes não direcionados no espaço da PCA (:func:`spacr.ops_tvn.tvn_on_controls`, um lote). ``'cosine'`` é o cosseno das linhas branqueadas. ``'shrunk'`` é ``x . y / sqrt((|x|^2 + c) (|y|^2 + c))``, com ``c`` sendo a média das normas ao quadrado das linhas não direcionadas (a contagem de componentes após o branqueamento): um gene cujo sinal não supera o dos controles fica próximo de zero, o que o cosseno simples não consegue fazer em uma vista com poucas colunas, onde genes não relacionados frequentemente apontam na mesma direção.

records.context: Laboratory microplate-scale runs (item 872, alpha): ``ops_ph_acquisitions`` names each phenotype acquisition's folder and channels (:func:`_ph_acquisition_index`); ``ops_ph_pipeline`` and ``ops_ph_stage_dir`` stream the microscope fields of view (:func:`_ph_fields`); ``ops_archive_root`` copies each finished well to archive storage, verifies it and resumes from its ``WELL_DONE`` marker (:func:`_ph_archive_resume`); ``ops_gpu_admission`` waits for a free card first (:func:`_ops_admitted_run`). The alpha ``"flat_nuclear"`` and ``"flat_validate"`` phases (item 912) run alone: they build each laboratory microplate's nuclear-median DNA flat-microscope field of view map and check it on held-out microscope fields of view (:func:`spacr.ops_flatfield.run_flat_phases`). The alpha ``"score"`` phase (item 913) runs alone: it scores gene profiles and clusterings with copairs and EFAAR (:func:`spacr.ops_scoring.score_ops_profiles`). The profile path's alpha ``"cluster_sweep"`` (item 916, the Leiden resolution sweep), ``"etest"`` (item 917, the per-gene E-test and its statistical detection sensitivity curve), ``"cluster_consensus"`` (item 928, guide-bootstrap consensus clustering), ``"cluster_bench_test"`` (item 929, the calibrated consensus test) and ``"cluster_maxproj"`` (item 992, max-projection clustering over feature views) phases run inside :func:`spacr.ops_tvn.run_profile_phases`. Like the profile path, the flat-microscope field of view and score phases hold the BLAS and OpenMP pools at ``ops_blas_threads`` threads while ``ops_deterministic_blas`` is on (the result's ``blas_threads``). With ``ops_layout`` set to ``'cpg_cropped'`` (alpha, items 919 and 920) only ``"cpg_index"``, ``"cpg_merged"`` and ``"prefix_decode"`` run (:func:`spacr.cpg_cropped.run_cpg_phases`, :func:`spacr.ops_prefix.run_prefix_decode`); the default phases mean the first two, and the decode too under ``ops_library_mode='spacer_prefix'``.

records.source: Plate-scale runs (item 872, alpha): ``ops_ph_acquisitions`` names each phenotype acquisition's folder and channels (:func:`_ph_acquisition_index`); ``ops_ph_pipeline`` and ``ops_ph_stage_dir`` stream the fields (:func:`_ph_fields`); ``ops_archive_root`` copies each finished well to archive storage, verifies it and resumes from its ``WELL_DONE`` marker (:func:`_ph_archive_resume`); ``ops_gpu_admission`` waits for a free card first (:func:`_ops_admitted_run`). The alpha ``"flat_nuclear"`` and ``"flat_validate"`` phases (item 912) run alone: they build each plate's nuclear-median DNA flat-field map and check it on held-out fields (:func:`spacr.ops_flatfield.run_flat_phases`). The alpha ``"score"`` phase (item 913) runs alone: it scores gene profiles and clusterings with copairs and EFAAR (:func:`spacr.ops_scoring.score_ops_profiles`). The profile path's alpha ``"cluster_sweep"`` (item 916, the Leiden resolution sweep), ``"etest"`` (item 917, the per-gene E-test and its power curve), ``"cluster_consensus"`` (item 928, guide-bootstrap consensus clustering), ``"cluster_bench_test"`` (item 929, the calibrated consensus test) and ``"cluster_maxproj"`` (item 992, max-projection clustering over feature views) phases run inside :func:`spacr.ops_tvn.run_profile_phases`. Like the profile path, the flat-field and score phases hold the BLAS and OpenMP pools at ``ops_blas_threads`` threads while ``ops_deterministic_blas`` is on (the result's ``blas_threads``). With ``ops_layout`` set to ``'cpg_cropped'`` (alpha, items 919 and 920) only ``"cpg_index"``, ``"cpg_merged"`` and ``"prefix_decode"`` run (:func:`spacr.cpg_cropped.run_cpg_phases`, :func:`spacr.ops_prefix.run_prefix_decode`); the default phases mean the first two, and the decode too under ``ops_library_mode='spacer_prefix'``.
records.translation: Execuções em escala de placa (item 872, alfa): ``ops_ph_acquisitions`` nomeia a pasta e os canais de cada aquisição de fenótipo (:func:`_ph_acquisition_index`); ``ops_ph_pipeline`` e ``ops_ph_stage_dir`` transmitem os campos de visão em fluxo (:func:`_ph_fields`); ``ops_archive_root`` copia cada poço concluído para o armazenamento de arquivo, verifica-o e retoma a partir do seu marcador ``WELL_DONE`` (:func:`_ph_archive_resume`); ``ops_gpu_admission`` espera primeiro por uma placa de vídeo livre (:func:`_ops_admitted_run`). As fases alfa ``"flat_nuclear"`` e ``"flat_validate"`` (item 912) são executadas sozinhas: constroem o mapa de campo plano do canal DNA baseado na mediana nuclear de cada placa e o verificam em campos de visão reservados (:func:`spacr.ops_flatfield.run_flat_phases`). A fase alfa ``"score"`` (item 913) é executada sozinha: pontua perfis gênicos e agrupamentos com copairs e EFAAR (:func:`spacr.ops_scoring.score_ops_profiles`). As fases alfa ``"cluster_sweep"`` (item 916, a varredura de resoluções do Leiden), ``"etest"`` (item 917, o E-test por gene e sua curva de potência), ``"cluster_consensus"`` (item 928, agrupamento de consenso por bootstrap de guias), ``"cluster_bench_test"`` (item 929, o teste calibrado do consenso) e ``"cluster_maxproj"`` (item 992, agrupamento por projeção máxima entre vistas de características) do caminho de perfis são executadas dentro de :func:`spacr.ops_tvn.run_profile_phases`. Assim como o caminho de perfis, as fases de campo plano e de pontuação mantêm os grupos de threads do BLAS e do OpenMP em ``ops_blas_threads`` threads enquanto ``ops_deterministic_blas`` está ativado (``blas_threads`` do resultado). Com ``ops_layout`` definido como ``'cpg_cropped'`` (alfa, itens 919 e 920), apenas ``"cpg_index"``, ``"cpg_merged"`` e ``"prefix_decode"`` são executadas (:func:`spacr.cpg_cropped.run_cpg_phases`, :func:`spacr.ops_prefix.run_prefix_decode`); as fases padrão significam as duas primeiras, e também a decodificação com ``ops_library_mode='spacer_prefix'``.
